title: Doolittle Raid -- B-25'S Launched, Tokyo Raid
description:
National Archives Footage - B-25'S Launched, Tokyo Raid
Local ID Number: 428-NPC-895

Creator: Department of Defense. Department of the Navy (Navy Photographic Center)
Produced: April 1942

Shot List: 1) MS ENTERPRISE underway USS NASHVILLE in heavy seas. 2) MS LS B-25s launched from HORNET-choppy sea-SV3)LS B-25 launched. SBD passes FG. 4) MS Bow of HORNET, rough sea. LS CA. 5) MS Pan launched B-25 in flight-rough sea. 6) SHS F4F lands, noses over, bends prop. 7) SHS SBD approaches, passes ENTERPRISE. 8) SHS SBD lands, crashes to catwalk.9) SHS Crashed SBD in catwalk, men approach. 10) MS F4F passes. SHS Crew around crashed SBD. 11) MS Pan SBD in flight. SHS F4F lands. 12) SHS F4F lands, flies overboard, is lost. 13) MS Pan SBD passes. SHS F4F lands. 14) LS Sunset, pan to color. 15) CU Man with binoculars, sunset BG.
keywords: USS Nashville, B-25, USS Enterprise, USS Hornet, Doolittle Raid, Col. James Doolittle
